title: CIMSA LOGISTICS
description:
In the warehousing logistics business for over 20 years, we provide best-in-class warehouse storage solutions for both manufacturing plants in northeast Mexico and their suppliers by allowing parts and raw materials to be stored minutes away from maquiladora plants.

Our personnel are individually and team driven to provide value and the flexibility required to meet all your service expectations.

We are flexible and innovative in the design of customized warehousing logistics plans that meet the most demanding use cases.

Part of the Amado Trucking, Inc. family of companies, we provide seamless warehousing and transportation solutions without equal in the industry.
